The parents are also very nice also said that they have no issues if the girl is going to continue to keep her faith after marrying their boy. But they do not wish their son to change his faith. Issues: (2) Is it correct for an individual to revert to Islam in secrecy of his parents and especially for a girl? (3) Will the boy be able to practice Islam in that house? We are requesting you to kindly guide us with either Fatwa or advise so as to make the decision easy for us. As we love our daughter like all parents; we are trying to work a way for her happiness. Kindly treat this matter as URGENT and reply as soon as possible. 4941 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 46091 Country: India Title: About sex with wife. Question: I know that we cannot make love during menstruation period of my wife, so we are not doing so. But some time her period got delayed for some days so we were making love that time and after finishing the act we feel some (very little) blood from her private parts then she told me that might be her period started, so my concern is that whether I did sin in that act? And I am so much in guilt for this. One thing is that before having sex she offered namaz also and we were sure that period was not started. Answer ID: 46091 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1032/805/B=1434) If you are sure that you did intercourse with your wife before the starting of haiz (menstruation) then there is no sin. If she experienced haiz after the intercourse then too there is no sin. It is sin to do intercourse in the state of haiz. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
